brief: A relatable office mix-up where a harmless misunderstanding turns into an unexpectedly funny team moment.
title: The "Urgent" Email
hook: That moment you realize you replied "Love you!" to your boss.
script:
(0:00-0:03) Shot of Employee typing furiously on a laptop with a focused face. Text overlay: "Sending a quick reply to my partner while multitasking."
(0:03-0:06) Close-up of the screen. We see an email from "Manager Mike" about a spreadsheet, but the cursor is in the reply box. The employee types: "Got it, love you! See you at 6! ❤️" and hits SEND.
(0:06-0:10) The employee freezes. Eyes widen. Slow-motion zoom on their face as the realization hits. Sound effect: Record scratch.
(0:10-0:15) Cut to the Manager walking over to the desk. He’s smiling. He leans in and whispers, "I love you too, but I still need those Q3 projections by noon."
(0:15-0:20) The whole team is seen in the background stifling laughs. Employee puts their head on the desk.
caption: I’m updating my resume as we speak. 💀💼 #OfficeLife #WorkFail #Relatable #CorporateHumor
